high: The fixed current manifest and active-run.guard each have link count 2 because another local checkout hardlinks the same inodes. owner.load_manifest already rejects the manifest with 'manifest path identity mismatch', and owner._require_active_guard would reject the guard for the same nlink != 1 condition. The reviewed closer therefore cannot prepare or execute against the exact current inputs.

The target-contract clause promises that a cut after durable sidecar publication may validate the same receipt and finish active-guard cleanup, but the implementation exposes only prepare and execute. execute rejects any existing RESULT, so a crash after publish(payload) and before owner._release_active_guard permanently strands the exact active guard with no idempotent finalizer path.
medium: fixed_inputs hashes journal and log paths with Path.read_bytes but does not require each pinned entry to be a direct regular, owner-matched, mode-safe, single-link file. The exact byte hashes stop content substitution but do not establish the direct-file identities required for authoritative retained evidence.

review_lease checks only whether any nested values are truthy. It does not enforce exact findings keys and list types or exact contacts keys and integer-zero types, so empty or structurally substituted nested objects can satisfy the review gate.

publish does not establish that SIDE_ROOT is a direct owner-controlled mode-0700 directory before opening RESULT. A pre-existing directory identity or mode is accepted, and RESULT itself is not read back and canonically revalidated before active-guard removal.

A cut or observer failure after HostRunner creates LOG_DIR and before sidecar publication is permanently non-resumable because subsequent execute rejects LOG_DIR.exists(). This sends no candidate or rollback effect, but it defeats the target contract's observer-repair model and leaves the active park without this closer.
